acceptanceCriteria: Edit button opens edit form with current deal values pre-filled
Edit form validates input with Zod dealSchema
Save updates deal in store and refreshes view
Cancel exits edit mode without saving
Confirmed delete removes deal from store and navigates to pipeline
Form uses input, select, textarea from ui components
notes: Note deliverables and payments are managed through the New Deal Wizard (Group C), not directly here. Edit only top-level deal properties.
